headlines.text: Stock futures hold mostly flat Tuesday as traders brace for the October CPI report, following Monday's 2.35% S&P 500 surge that pulled Wall Street out of correction territory
Fed's Waller warns a bigger rate hike may be needed as inflation risks tilt higher, with markets now pricing elevated odds of a December FOMC hike
October CPI lands at 8:30am ET Tuesday, the last big inflation read before the Fed's December meeting, with no official annual rate this month due to a shutdown-era data gap

Nvidia edges higher Tuesday as investors weigh the fallout from CEO Jensen Huang's admitted affair with a woman U.S. intelligence suspects is a Chinese spy, after the scandal erased nearly $200B in market value Monday
AST SpaceMobile shares sink roughly 12% premarket Tuesday after a Q3 earnings miss and a sharply higher capex outlook of $575-650M
Homebuilders extend their rally, with NVR jumping more than 26%, after Democrats won control of the Senate and House in the midterm elections
